## not-waiting

no escalation waits on a decision now: decide_escalation is only for one the owner handed you with a free answer; a person decides it on the banner, or by answering your question about it (ask_person, the escalation's actions as choices)

## not-answered

the owner has not answered your question about this escalation: only a person decides it. Ask them, or end your turn; a person decides it on the banner, or by answering your question about it (ask_person, the escalation's actions as choices)

## earlier-conductor

the owner's answer (question qst_e) was to an earlier conductor's question, not yours: ask them again yourself (ask_person, the escalation's actions as choices); a person decides it on the banner, or by answering your question about it (ask_person, the escalation's actions as choices)

## not-owner

the answer to your question qst_e is not the task's owner's: only the owner hands you an escalation; a person decides it on the banner, or by answering your question about it (ask_person, the escalation's actions as choices)

## not-admin

only the task's owner or an organisation admin can accept this; a person decides it on the banner, or by answering your question about it (ask_person, the escalation's actions as choices)
